_why: Pool-item vocabulary: canonical English labels seeded into every user's template pools (triggers, symptoms, medicines, reliefs, locations, activities, migraine types, wearable/auto-trigger metrics). The client translates them at render via t(label); the stored value stays English. Nothing in the Compose sources spells these out at a display site, so extract.py cannot scan them — they are declared here and merged into strings.json, which keeps them under the length gate and in the generated tables.
_budgets: class is hard because these render in chips and grid cells that cannot wrap; max_len is a flat 32, the widest such cell.
